none: PAS NLM-65AE57: Roman Coin: Nummus of Constantine I
contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin. Large module nummus, possibly of Constantine I (306-337), but with a possibly defaced reverse, now illegible. Obverse description: Bust laureate cuirassed right. Obverse inscription: DN [---]NTINVS PF [---]. Reverse description: possibly a figure left, battered. Diameter: 22.6mm, Weight: 3.35gms, die axis: possibly 6
